text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Bright-san's Trainer!! Good 
mooorniiing!!
choice_data_list: Good morning. You're bursting with energy.
Good morning. You're bursting with energy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The great Lady Tsuru-chan has had no 
fever or cough since this morning, and is 
in tip-top shape~ today!
choice_data_list: I see, you two share a dorm room, right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So today I'm gonna be twice 
as pumped as usual... no, 200 times! Let's 
do this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, indeed it is~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—She didn't drop out of pool class! 
Tsuyoshi really is built different today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. You're still full of energy, 
aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Right now, I feel like I could swim 
for 24 hours straight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, who seemed 
to be in peak form, could be spotted all 
over the place—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bright-san's Trainer!! Do you have a 
moment right now!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I was just talking with Bright-san about 
this! Would you mind if I ran tandem with 
Bright-san after school today?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Long distance, if possible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm in good shape, I was told to 
practice at a longer distance than usual~
choice_data_list: I see... Got it, long distance it is.
I see... Got it, long distance it is.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Is it an OK!? Yaaaaaaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! If that's the case, I'm gonna 
eat and eat and eat my heart out!
choice_data_list:
Looks like your appetite's in top form 
too.

Looks like your appetite's in top form 
too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"After working so hard, you must be 
absolutely starving, aren't you~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All right. I shall partake in a grand 
feast as well~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after school...
choice_data_list:
Alright then, we'll go with 3000m on turf, 
clockwise!

Alright then, let's go with 3000m on turf, 
clockwise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Lady Tsuru-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Sorry, I was zoning in! Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi, fully prepared!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first, the two running side by side 
seemed to be doing fine. However, just as 
they entered the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*... *cough*... *gag*. I 
can't... go on~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, Lady Tsuru-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi suddenly slows down, 
Mejiro Bright, who was right behind her, 
swiftly moves in to support her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I did it again... *cough* *hack*...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No, but with how Tsuyoshi is today... With 
peak condition Tsuyoshi, a little rest 
should do it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Lady Tsuru-chan~ Close your eyes for a 
moment, and try listening to your body~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...O-On my body?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes... How are your heart and dear legs 
feeling? Are they having a hard time, I 
wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The frustration of things not going as 
intended... Oh, I know that feeling all 
too well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no need to rush. Neither 
for me, nor for Lady Tsuru.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Because, she's been working steadily and 
putting in the effort, you see~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As long as you water them and look after 
them, flowers will never wither.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If it does not wither, all that remains is 
to await the blooming season.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's each wait at our own pace. I shall 
relax lei~surely, while Lady Tsuru-chan 
takes a spirited rest~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Bright-san...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Bright-saaaaaaaaaaan!!
choice_data_list:
Bright's such a good upperclassman, isn't 
she?
Tsuyoshi's such a cute junior, isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Bright-saaaaaaaaaaan!!
choice_data_list:
Bright's such a good upperclassman, isn't 
she?
Tsuyoshi's such a cute junior, isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! They're always, always so 
kind...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Even when I'd get a fever, start coughing 
out of nowhere, or turn pale or flush red, 
you'd always stay so calm..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Tsuru-chan~, please have a drink~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"They're being so sweet to me like this~! 
Waaah, I love them so much~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Let's do our best tomorrow in our 
own way too~. *squeeze*~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. And usually, she's very dependable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They comb my hair every morning and help 
me get ready for school.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thanks to that, I can get to school 
every morning without having to rush, and 
it has been so~ very helpful~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. You're always looking after me when 
I'm sick or studying, so this is the least 
I can do...!

text_block_list.name: Bright & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeees. Yes!
